messages:
maria: Starting preflight for FK backfill on orders -> customers. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight. planning to use lease-sentinel to avoid table-wide locks. please ack if you have any blockers.
leo: ack, i'll own the runbooks and rollback path. are we pinning app to v3.4.2 for the window?
sam: yes pin v3.4.2 for the rollout, canary first 10% traffic. release notes updated (link: https://internal/release/notes/347).
maria: deploybot, schedule migrate-job-2026-03-21 to 02:15 UTC, canary 10% for 15m then ramp to 100% over 30m.
deploybot: @maria scheduled migrate-job-2026-03-21 at 2026-03-21T02:15:00Z. Canary window 02:15-02:30 UTC. Notify channel at start.
anya: quick question: backfill will use chunked updates with pk ranges, right? we want max 30s per chunk to avoid long locks.
maria: correct — chunk_size=5000, pause_between_chunks=2s. using background worker pool of 6.
leo: added a sentinel lease check in the worker: if lease_missing -> auto-abort + notify oncall.
anya: put this in release notes too: abort criteria: >5min lock on any shard OR >10% error rate in canary.
sam: rollback plan: if abort triggered, flip app pinned version back to v3.4.1 and disable the feature flag customer_fk_fallback. manual run to revert partial rows using revert-backfill script.
maria: putting revert commands here for quick access:
```
-- abort manual
UPDATE backfill_jobs SET status='aborted' WHERE id=20260321_01;
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%backfill_chun%';
```
leo: also monitoring query to watch for long locks:
```
SELECT now()-pg_stat_activity.query_start AS duration, pid, query
FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active' AND query ILIKE '%UPDATE orders%';
```
oncall-bot: If lock > 5 minutes on any orders shard, paging oncall @sam.
sam: i'll be on standby 02:00-04:30 UTC. set my phone to do-not-disturb off.
maria: one more: deploybot, pin runtime-allocator to commit 9cde3f for the job to avoid scheduler changes during the window.
deploybot: runtime-allocator pinned to 9cde3f for migrate-job-2026-03-21.
leo: test checklist done: dry-run on staging, happy path, abort path, TTL on lease works.
anya: performance note: expect peak replication lag +20s for the first 10 minutes, alert thresholds set.
sam: set temporary rate-limit on writes to 200qps for tenants flagged in the canary to reduce contention.
maria: final: if anything unexpected, use escape hatch: feature flag off -> revert pin -> abort backfill. otherwise proceed. :rocket: :eyes:
leo: thanks all — i'll post a concise ops checklist at T-30m.
sam: thanks, see you in the channel at 02:10 UTC.
deploybot: Reminder: migrate-job-2026-03-21 will post start message in #eng-releases at 2026-03-21T02:15:00Z.
